video_title: LaMelo Ball TRADED To The Timberwolves, Giannis Traded To The Heat + 2016 Cavs Trip Recap

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The Road Trippin' group's 2016 Cavs reunion trip
quotes.excerpt: Every activity we did, 99% of it was us together all the time.
quotes.quote: I appreciate about this group, every activity we did, 99% of it was us together all the time. All you see here is the laughing and the joking and the dancing, for we were around each other 15 to 16 hours a day, all day, every day. There was never a time where I was like, I'm getting tired of these guys.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The 2016 Cavs reunion trip was a special experience
quotes.excerpt: It felt like we were on a road trip. It felt like we were on a road trip.
quotes.quote: It felt like we were on a road trip. It felt like we were on a road trip. But the coolest thing I think when people ask is that we were together, but there wasn't a TV on one time. Everyone was just laughing, drinking, chilling. It was cool to kind of relive because all of social was talking about the 10-year anniversary of it, and then our group got together, so that just added some more fun.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson's lack of motivation to join the workout
quotes.excerpt: I'm not getting paid $50 million. If I was, there would be motivation.
quotes.quote: I'm not getting paid $50 million. If I was, there would be motivation. There would be motivation. No, I'm not getting paid $50 million. If I was, there would be motivation.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The story behind ordering 20 Aperol Spritzes
quotes.excerpt: We were crushing them for breakfast and breakfast and lunch and you're crushing them.
quotes.quote: When you order an Aperol Spritz, they just give you the glass. So we said, hey, there's a bunch of us, can we get like 20? Which isn't that a big a deal, right? There was a guy making our Aperol Spritz for about two hours straight. We were crushing them for breakfast and breakfast and lunch and you're crushing them. And it was like, you do it, and it's like, normally they would bring you like three or four. And when we ordered like 10 of them, they're like, we're just going to have somebody come down here and keep making them.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love's golf performance during the trip
quotes.excerpt: Kevin had some days where he was bad and then all of a sudden he got really good.
quotes.quote: Kevin had some days where he was bad and then all of a sudden he got really good. He was hot in the beginning, slowed down in the middle, got hot again at the end.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's improvement as a golfer
quotes.excerpt: His swing was so trash at the beginning of watching him play and posting clips.
quotes.quote: His swing was so trash at the beginning of watching him play and posting clips, and literally by the end, it was, bro, you almost look like a golfer. You almost look like you know, no, I'm being serious. He's in the sand, he chips out, he one-putts, and you're like, the fuck is going on here?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The group chat dynamics of the 2016 Cavs
quotes.excerpt: The group chat from the team, there's like six of us, and it's been the same six.
quotes.quote: When we talk about the group chat from the team, there's like six of us, and it's been the same six. There was the full team group chat, then there was the guys that were J.R., Swish, Tristan, Kevin, Channing, and Bron. So that's the group of us. And then we start doing, hey guys, we should get together, do some golf and go do this, and then a conversation kind of got started is, and like, hey, it would be wrong if we didn't invite some of the other guys because it's going to look like, we're calling it this championship. No, it was the group chat from the championship team, not the championship team group chat.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The significance of the Timberwolves' trade for Julius Randle
quotes.excerpt: This has a huge sign about the league in itself. We're going back to the big three wave.
quotes.quote: I think this has a huge sign about the league in itself. And what they're saying is, we're going back to the big three wave, right? Because you look at this year who won, right? It was OG, the duo, KAT, your talent, and Jalen Brunson, right? Then you go back to who won last year, Jalen Williams, J-Dub, SGA, and Chet. Then you would, let's say the Spurs would have won, they would have had, you know, Wembanyama, so and so, so and so. And so now you look at what's the the recipe for winning, and you're going, what do we need? So we got Jaden McDaniels is taking a huge step. We have our superstar, now we need that guy who's going to make everyone else better.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle's potential as a superstar in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: Julius Randle is a good pickup. I don't know if they have enough pieces.
quotes.quote: With LaMelo, it's all about the level of basketball that he plays. There's no question about his talent, there's no question about his ability, he has the ability to be a superstar in this league. But it's like the Minnesota Timberwolves have been to the conference finals twice. That's a different type of basketball in the last three years. That's a different type of basketball that you have to play. Julius Randle is a good pickup. I don't know if they have enough pieces, but Julius Randle is a good pickup.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle's status as an All-Star player
quotes.excerpt: Even if he's not an All-NBA player right now, he's an All-Star player right now.
quotes.quote: You understand what Julius Randle is. Even if he's not an All-NBA player right now, he's an All-Star player right now. All-NBA is top 15, he's been that twice. All-Star is a top 25 player. I think he's right in that range.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo's role in the Miami Heat's offense
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo is great with shot creation and on the ball.
quotes.quote: Bam Adebayo is great with shot creation and on the ball. I think his shot selection will probably have to improve. That's an understanding, but that's the difference between playing on a team that is trying to make a playoff and playing on a team that's trying to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of team chemistry in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I've never rooted for the Knicks so hard in my life.
quotes.quote: I have never rooted for the Knicks so hard in my life. I've never rooted for the Knicks more in my life. If the Knicks goes six or seven, I don't get to go on that trip with my brothers. And so, what once the Knicks had control, I was sitting there like, please, please win. They won the game. I'm like, hey, Knicks in five, congratulations Knicks, you guys are awesome, I'm out.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves's contract with the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: It will be the richest contract for an undrafted player ever.
quotes.quote: It will be the richest contract for an undrafted player ever. AR said his contract with the wonderful photo of him on the golf course laying on his back is a sigh of relief.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers' salary cap flexibility after the Austin Reaves deal
quotes.excerpt: The team could have more than 50 million in cap space to build the roster.
quotes.quote: The team could have more than 50 million in cap space to build the roster even with Austin's deal.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenge of maintaining team morale during a playoff series
quotes.excerpt: When your team is down 3-1, there's not a lot of positivity.
quotes.quote: When your team is down 3-1, there's not a lot of positivity. When your team is blowing leads, our job is to narrate the story of the things that are going on. So if the Knicks come back from down 29, there's not going to be a lot of positive positivity on the air.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of becoming an NBA head coach
quotes.excerpt: There's one of 30 jobs in the entire world. There's 30 jobs.
quotes.quote: There's one of 30 jobs in the entire world. There's 30 jobs in the entire world. And certain guys like Micah, Micah worked me out getting ready for the draft up in Toronto. He was leading our workouts and our draft workout. Micah has been an elite dude, great dude for years. And a lot of these guys like Jamal Mosley, he I think Jamal Mosley might have interviewed for head coaching jobs, he might have did like seven or eight different interviews, and then he gets the job. Why would anybody ever take the Sacramento job? It's one of 30.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of player salary increases on team building
quotes.excerpt: The NBA, the player salaries are going to go keep going up every single year.
quotes.quote: The NBA, the player salaries are going to go keep going up every single year. So we're like, oh, this guy is not worth 70 million. It's like, yes, in the market value of this, this and this, yes he is. If you go, the minimum salary in the league right now for a veteran is 4.5 million dollars. When I was eight years ago, it it it was 1.5, then it jumped to 2.5, now it's 4.5. So when I say this, it's like the minimum salary in the NBA is 4.5.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of becoming an NBA head coach compared to a player
quotes.excerpt: It's statistically harder to be a coach in the NBA than it is to be a player.
quotes.quote: It's statistically harder to be a coach in the NBA than it is to be a player. So like, let's put that in in perspective. So like, I'm always going to lean towards the positive in my assessment. And if they underperform based off lack of help, that's not their fault, that's not our fault, that's just the the luck of the draw.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenges of managing a team with a one-year coaching contract
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't even give the coach command. That doesn't even put him in a position.
quotes.quote: It doesn't even give the coach command. That doesn't even put him in a position. And I think the group in the locker room that they have in Portland's great, that's not an issue. But like, that's like listening to your stepdad. You're not my daddy. You know what I'm saying? You're not my real dad. That that's literally what it is.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson

He was leading our workouts and our draft workout. Micah has been an elite dude, great dude for years. And a lot of these guys like Jamal Mosley, he I think Jamal Mosley might have interviewed for head coaching jobs, he might have did like seven or eight different interviews, and then he gets the job. Why would anybody ever take the Sacramento job? It's one of 30.

quotes.summary_phrase: Allie Clifton's prediction for the Atlanta Hawks' season
quotes.excerpt: I think they will win at least 42 games.
quotes.quote: I think they will win at least 42 games.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson predicts the Atlanta Hawks will finish around .500
quotes.excerpt: I think they'll be about 500.
quotes.quote: I think they'll be about 500. They should be. Dude, they just got the number.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson praises the Atlanta Hawks' acquisition of Dyson Daniels and Zaccharie Risacher
quotes.excerpt: I think this is great for them. They're finally established who they are.
quotes.quote: I think this is great for them. I think they're finally established who they are and what an Atlanta Hawk player is. And adding a guy like Dyson Daniels, who's thirsty, who's been waiting for his opportunity, but who's won a chip, bringing over culture guys, bringing over, like, they brought over a guy who won a championship in Golden State. They brought over a guy who won a championship in OKC. They're adding great young pieces to build that culture, right? And I think that's the way to do it.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains why the Oklahoma City Thunder had to trade Josh Giddey
quotes.excerpt: They can't afford to keep these guys. You bring in Alex Caruso, he's still on a rookie deal.
quotes.quote: They can't afford to keep these guys. That's the thing. They can't afford to keep them. You bring in Alex Caruso, he's still on a rookie deal. Why? Because now Josh Giddey has to go, and there's nothing like, so because they can't afford to pay Josh Giddey what he's going to like, what he's going to warrant. It's going to be hard to keep all of those guys together in OKC, especially when you got those three big contracts that are hitting. So you kind of, you change the timetable. Josh Giddey is up this year, okay, we're going to trade him and we're going to bring in Alex Caruso, who has two more years left on his rookie deal. That's how Sam Presti has to stay ahead, right? That's what they're able to do.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson's analysis of the Memphis Grizzlies' roster strategy
quotes.excerpt: I kind of like what Memphis is doing. They're going back to the grind house.
quotes.quote: I kind of like what Memphis is doing. They're like, we're going back to the grind house with just quality young guys. We're going to be tough again and this is the culture we're going to build. And so, you know, obviously getting Brandon Clarke, he's a workhorse. He's just a good dude, he's a good player, and I think to just continue to add players like that is how you need to build. Look at what every great team has done, OKC, Boston, San Antonio. I even like, I mean, even the Hawks have done a really good job. A lot of these new up-and-coming teams just start with those guys and that's how you build your culture.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson reflects on his time playing for the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: Going back to Phoenix. That was one thing that I was always jealous of you.
quotes.quote: Shout out to my guy Cojo Pete. Going back to Phoenix. Channing, you know, that was one thing that I was always jealous of you, that you got to play in Phoenix. I was always jealous of you. I would have never left.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson's assessment of Cojo Pete's potential
quotes.excerpt: There's certain guys that just know how to win and the kid's a winner.
quotes.quote: There's certain guys that just know how to win and the kid's a winner. And I think, you know, with the 30th pick and Phoenix gets to keep him, it is congratulations to Cojo Pete. You might not always go as high as you want, you might not always go where you want, but you are where you're supposed to be. You're where you're supposed to be. And I'm happy for him, and I think Phoenix probably, you know, got one of the steals of the draft.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson emphasizes the importance of the off-season for player development
quotes.excerpt: The off-season is the most important season. What you do, how hard you work.
quotes.quote: The off-season is the most important season. What you do, how hard you work, the increments that you pick. You can pick 1.5 things to improve on every off-season, right? Going left, figuring out your pull-up, getting better. Like really just find something that you're focusing on in that off-season and just hours upon hours upon hours of rep. You can become a C-shooter to a B-minus shooter. That is a huge jump. That's a huge jump. And so to do that, to put in those work. And another thing that I think young players forget is the off-season is the most important because you can 100% focus. In the season, in the season, still pick one thing.
